overdueTitle: Completion target exceeded. Review the original job.
overdueBody: The accepted provisional target has passed without delivery. Human review is needed; this alert does not mean that a person has been notified or that support is staffed.
unavailable: Completion timing is unavailable for this recorded job. No target or refund promise is inferred.
paymentPending: An original creator payment is still recorded as pending. Expiry or delay does not prove that it failed.
paymentBoundary: The job crossed a creator-payment boundary. Missing or definitive recorded legs do not prove that every call is resolved.
paymentUnknown: Original creator-payment evidence is unavailable or inconsistent.
originalOnly: Keep the original job and payment reference. Do not pay again to recover this job. Wait, partial-delivery and refund choices require a separately confirmed policy.
observation: This state was calculated when status was checked. There is no new background alert or notification service.

failure.operator_reviewed_no_result: Original job closed without a saved result
